details.reviewMethod: Static data-flow inspection plus expired-deadline fixture; no simulated game clock or browser timing claim.

findings.detail: Original per-search-only caps could accumulate across demonstration candidates. Reviewed source now shares one absolute 2000ms deadline across initial plan and demonstration subsearches.

Original branch retried any foldsUsed mismatch after one second. Reviewed source allows retry only with exactly unchanged count and geometry; both altered-counter and altered-geometry observations now throw.

limitations: These authored visible-board and fault-observation fixtures are not three-level gameplay or production-model rule proof.
Geometry checks are deliberately small representative cases; architecture owns the independent full geometry/solver oracle.
Time caps are cooperative checks around bounded operations. No operating-system scheduling or physical device responsiveness guarantee is asserted.
No browser, native input bridge, recording, signed APK or production model was executed.
